english.note: Use this for a quiet or slow period in business, trade, or activity.

examples.english: Business has been slack lately, and it is really hard to make money.
examples.traditional: 最近市道好淡，做生意真係難做。
examples.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 si5 dou6 hou2 taam5 zou6 saang1 ji3 zan1 hai6 naan4 zou6

english.note: Use 淡 when food or drink tastes weak or insufficiently seasoned rather than completely flavourless.

examples.english: This soup is tasteless and needs more salt.
examples.jyutping: ni1 bou1 tong1 taam5 zo2 di1 jiu3 gaa1 jim4
